sources: https://www.coldwaterks.org/coldwater-lake.html (the City of Coldwater's own site, read 2026-11-06): '250 acre man-made lake held within a 930 acre park within the Coldwater city limits'; 'Those with campers and trailers will find adequate campsites with water and electric hookups, as well as sanitary facilities at various points around the lake'; 'The lake is owned and operated by the city of Coldwater'; 'contact the information booth at Lake Coldwater, the phone number is 620-582-2702'; the 2026 Seasonal Camper Lease Agreement and 2026 fee schedule posted.

https://www.coldwaterks.org/uploads/1/1/9/6/119680421/lake_fee_schedule_-_2026.pdf (2026 SCHEDULE OF USER FEES FOR LAKE COLDWATER, read 2026-11-06): 'Camping Fees: $28.00 per night with electric, water & sewer hookups / $26.00 per night with electric & water hookups / $20.50 per night for camper without hookups / $10.00 per night for tent camping'; monthly $335 + electricity (W/E), $360 + electricity 'on west hill top with sewer hookups', $235 without hookups; vehicle permits '3 DAY PERMIT' $5 Comanche County resident / $10 out-of-county, season $15/$20; '3% credit card fee'; cabins $75.

https://www.coldwaterks.org/uploads/1/1/9/6/119680421/seasonal_camper_lease_agreement_2026.pdf (read 2026-11-06): seasonal sites leased for 'the 2026 Camping Season, which begins on April 1, 2026, and ends on September 30, 2026'; a lessee mows 'their entire camping area which is defined by neighbors, roadways and waterways, but not to exceed 85 feet x 45 feet'; holdover at 'the then current daily rate charged to overnight campers'; Lessor (620) 582-2940.

https://coldwaterks.com/coldwater-lake/ (the stored website, read 2026-11-06): NOT the city's site. A re-skinned dropped domain: 'Information on this page is preserved from the reviewed City of Coldwater source material', an 'Editorial Policy', ad-consent banner, and an Articles Archive of 'Preserved legacy route' posts such as 'Hibachi Vs Teriyaki' and 'Sushi For Beginners Guide'.

Esri World Imagery at 37.2505,-99.3560 (1.3 km), 37.2505,-99.3533 (260 m), 37.2520,-99.3525 and 37.2492,-99.3528 (110 m), 2026-11-06: west-shore camping in three parts: a lakeside lane north of the pin with trailers parked on its water side 10-25 m from the shoreline across open grass and shore trees; a treed loop south of the pin with RVs 20-40 m from the water across open grass, no road between; and an inland loop ~150-250 m west of the shore (W/E pads among trees). The pin 37.25114,-99.35302 is at the junction of the shore lane, ~70 m from the water.

values.note: City of Coldwater 2026: $20.50 a night for an RV without hookups, $26 with water and electric, $28 with water, electric and sewer; tents $10. A lake vehicle permit is also required: $10 for 3 days from outside Comanche County ($5 in-county). Monthly from $335 plus electricity. 3% card fee.

LONG-STAY (five tests, needs a look): the city runs a seasonal lease program (April 1-September 30 leases, April rent due by February 28; lot 'defined by neighbors, roadways and waterways, but not to exceed 85 feet x 45 feet'), plus monthly rates. It also posts nightly rates for 'overnight campers' and sells 3-day vehicle permits, so it does sell nights to travellers. The city states no share of seasonal vs overnight sites. Imagery shows many trailers with golf carts and sheds along the north shore lane, consistent with leased lots. Lean keep as a municipal lake park with posted nightly rates. AWH call if the seasonal share is known to be high.

WATERFRONT lakefront supported (per row): (1) north shore lane: trailers parked on the water side of the lane, 10-25 m from the shoreline across open mown grass and scattered shore trees, no road or day use between. That is on-water if these are public overnight sites, but some or all may be seasonal leases, unknown. (2) south treed loop: RVs 20-40 m from the water across open grass under trees, no road between. That earns lakefront for the shore-side row. (3) inland loop 150-250 m west: not waterfront. No downgrade lead; if the shore rows turn out to be seasonal-only, the overnight sites may be the inland loop and a view at best.

Unconfirmed stored values: '48 hookup sites', '30-amp' and 'vehicles to 40 ft' appear on no city page (the city's page and fee PDF give no count, amperage or length; AllStays lists 100 sites incl. 21 full and 79 W/E at 30 A). Left as stored (derived); the full-hookup ($28) and W/E ($26) tiers confirm water and sewer exist. Showers/dump: the city says only 'sanitary facilities'.

Season/booking not stated by the city for overnight campers (the lease season is Apr 1-Sep 30; payment at the lake booth). No online booking. Shelters by reservation only. No sand-rule issue. Pin fine.
